integrity: The identity, nonpositive-root interlacing, exchangeable polarization, and stationary-limit closure are the analytic proof. Exact finite-state tests are supplementary; no independent mathematical validation or proof of historical priority has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Uniform arrivals, initially empty occupancy, independent post-arrival deletions with the same deterministic per-round loss probability across labels; fixed-rate stationarity for 0<p<1. No assertion for heterogeneous arrivals or label-dependent losses.
title: Strong Rayleigh persistence in a lossy coupon collection process
